mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 550.0 and RSAFS > 350000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 90.0 (index 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 90.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a stable or rising GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong aggregate demand momentum, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 350000.0 and GDPC1 > 13200.0 in the prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and GDPC1 exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a low federal funds rate, signals that the Fed is behind the curve, increasing expectations of future rate hikes, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 9.5% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 130,000 signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 9.5 and PAYEMS > 130000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 9.5 and PAYEMS > 130000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 13200.0 billion dollars, combined with stable or rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 13200.0 and HOUST > 550.0 in the prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 > 13200.0 and HOUST > 550.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
